adaptations: Copied self-contained raw and Aspire fixture trees, not submodules.

The README-only raw fixture is a separate copy of the application's sources, build configuration, Compose dependency definition and MIT license, with all lifecycle scripts omitted; its README documents individual manual commands.

By explicit user naming decision, the existing management-script fixture is preserved as raw-scripted. Historical runs recorded as raw before this change used that scripted fixture; original artifacts must be interpreted with their recorded harness commit/provenance.
Raw control removes inactive ServiceDefaults project/references, OTel startup hooks, and checkpoint documentation.
raw-scripted Bash launcher accepts run-scoped ports and Compose project; PowerShell helpers are omitted to avoid unsafe fixed-port alternatives.
Aspire AppHost project paths are relative to the self-contained fixture.
All fixtures pin PostgreSQL 18.3 and Redis 8.6 to match the Aspire 13.6 integration defaults.
All fixtures select a stable .NET 10 SDK via global.json; the file-based AppHost opts out of central package management for its explicit directives.
Aspire container and data-volume names require a unique BENCH_RUN_ID; no persistent resources are reused.
All documented launch paths use npm ci so normal dependency installation preserves the snapshotted lockfile.
Fixture READMEs document their own launch method without describing other variants.
